tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ ma hā san+dhi d+dh+ya na bi shrān+ta nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya ba dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ma'i rang bzhin mkha' mnyam dag pa'i dbyings/ /chos mchog mi g.yo shin tu spros dang bral/ /'od gsal sems nyid byang chub snying po la/ / gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med par phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa shin tu rmad byung gang*/ /so so rang rig ye shes rtogs bya'i phyir/ /rgyud lung man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus te/ /ji ltar nyams su blangs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /ri rtse nags khrod mtsho gling la sogs pa/ /dus bzhi yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo zhi ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /'od gsal spros dang bral ba bsgom par bya/ /gnas dang gang zag nyams su blang bya'i chos/ /rnam gsum rang bzhin dag las 'grub par 'gyur/ /dang po gnas ni dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ /dus bzhi'i rnal 'byor dag dang mthun pa ste/ /dbyar ni gangs dang ri rtse la gsol par/ /smyug ma 'od ma 'jag khang la sogs par/ /bsil sar bsil khang nang du bsgom par bya/ /ston ni nags khrod ri ngogs brag rdzong sogs/ /bsil drod snyoms pa'i gnas dang khang bu ru/ /zas gos spyod lam de dang mthun par bya/ /dgun ni nags khrod brag phug sa khung sogs/ /dma' ba'i gnas dag dro ba'i sa phyogs su/ /zas gos mal cha la sogs rjes mthun bya/ /dpyid ni ri dang nags 'dab mtsho gling dang*/ / bsil drod snyoms par rjes mthun khang pa ru/ /zas gos spyod lam mthun pa shin tu gces/ /phyi nang rten 'brel gcig pas de yi phyir/ /yid 'ong dben la nyams dga'i gnas la brten/ /ri rtse shes pa dwangs la rgya che bas/ /bying ba gseng ba'i gnas te bskyed rim shis/ /gangs khrod ting 'dzin gsal zhing rig pa dngas/ /lhag mthong bsgom pa'i gnas yin bar chad nyung*/ /nags khrod shes pa gnas shing sems gnas skye/

/zhi gnas bsgom pa'i gnas te bde shas che/ /brag ri'i drung ni mi rtag skyo shas che/ /dngas la byin che zhi lhag zung 'brel 'grub/ /chu bo'i 'gram ni blo sna thung ba ste/ /nges 'byung 'phral la gsar du skye bar byed/ /dur khrod byin che dngos grub myur ba ste/ /bskyed rdzogs gang la'ang mchog tu shes par gsungs/ /grong dang tshong dus khang stong shing gcig sogs/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po rgyu ba ni/ /las dang po la g.yeng zhing bar du gcod/ /brtan pa rnams la grogs te mchog tu bsngags/ /lha khang mchod rten rgyal 'gong gnas sa ni/ /sems 'tshubs zhe sdang rtog tshogs skye ba ste/ /sa phug la sogs bsen mo'i gnas rnams su/ /'dod chags skye zhing bying rgod lhag par che/ /shing gcig la sogs ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /brag dang ri sna dmu btsan the'u rang gnas/ /sems 'tshub rkyen dang bar chad mang bar 'dod/ /gdol pa klu gnyan sa bdag gnas sa ni/ /mtsho 'gram ne'u gseng nags khrod la sogs te/ /yid dga' me tog ljon shing brgyan pa ni/ / dang po dga' yang phyis nas bar chad mang*/ /mdor na gnas khang dang po nyams dga' la/ /'dris shing mi dga' dngos grub chung ba'i gnas/ /dang po 'jigs la mi dga' 'dris shing dga'/ /byin che dngos grub che la bar chad med/ /de las gzhan kun bar ma phan gnod med/ /gnas la brten nas rang gi sems 'gyur zhing*/ /dge ba'i sbyor ba 'phel 'grib gnyis yod pas/ /sa gnas brtag pa shin tu gces par gsungs/ /de yang bsdu na las bzhi'i gnas kyang bzhi/ /zhi gnas yid ni lhan gyis 'dzin pa ste/ /rgyas gnas yid dga' gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan/ /dbang gnas yid 'phrog chags dang ldan pa ste/ /drag gnas sems rtsub 'jigs dngangs skye bar byed/ /dbye ba rnam pa grangs mang mtha' las 'das/ /'dir ni ting 'dzin zhi ba'i gnas mchog ste/ /gzhan rnams yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/

/zhi ba'i gnas der bsam gtan khang bu yang*/ /dben la yid 'dzin bkod par 'tshams pa ste/ /phyogs phyed mthongs gsal che ba rab tu shis//mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor mun khang 'khor ma ste/ /mtho sar 'khor khang dbus su lte ba'i tshul/ /byang du sngas gtad mya ngan 'das gzims bzhin/ /nyin mo'i gnas ni snang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gangs dang chu 'bab nags dang yul la sogs/ /khyams kyi mthong gsal che zhing nam mkha' yangs/ /sems gsal dngas la bsil drod snyoms par bya/ /zhi gnas dus su dben khang ra bas bskor/ /ngang gis sems gnas skye ba'i gnas shis la/ /lhag mthong dus su mthongs gsal dngas ba gces/ /rgyun du yid dga' dus dang mthun pa gces/ /nags rong la sogs dma' zhing 'thibs pa ni/ /zhi gnas gnas yin gangs sogs mtho sa nyid/ / lhag mthong gnas yin bye brag shes par gces/ /mdor na sa phyogs dang ni dben khang nyid/ /gang du nges 'byung skyo shas blo sna thung*/ /ting 'dzin 'phel la dge la sbyor ba'i gnas/ /snying po byang chub gnas dang mtshungs pas bstan/ / gang du gnas pas dge 'grib nyon mongs 'phel/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi tshe 'di'i dbang gyur na/ /las ngan bdud kyi gnas te mkhas pas spang*/ /'di dag rang byung pad+mas gsungs pa'i phyir/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gis shes par bya/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso las/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i sa phyogs bstan pa ste gnas dang po'o// // gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i gang zag kyang*/ /dad brtson nges 'byung skyo shas dang ldan zhing*/ /'khor bas skyo ngal thar pa don du gnyer/ /tshe 'di blos btang phyi ma'i byang chub 'dod/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi rgyang bsring nyon mongs chung*/ /khong yangs spro ring dag snang mos gus che/ /bstan la sri zhur ldan pa de dag gis/ /dam pa'i bla ma rab tu mnyes byas te/ /thos bsam bsgom pas rang gi sems sbyong zhing*/ /khyad par snyan rgyud snying po'i man ngag la/

/brtson la yun ring sgrub pas nyin mtshan 'da'/ /tha mal phyogs su skad cig ma yengs par/ /yang zab snying po'i don la nan tan bya/ /nyan thos byang chub sems dang rig pa 'dzin/ /sdom pa gsum po dag dang ma 'gal bas/ /rang rgyud sdom zhing gzhan phan ci 'grub dang*/ /ci snang thar pa'i lam du bsgyur bar bya/ las dang po yis gtso bor rang don sgrub/ /dben par sems gzung rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi btang*/ /rkyen ngan spang zhing gnyen pos nyon mongs 'dul/ /lta spyod ma 'dzol sgom pa lhur blang zhig*/ /dug lnga rang rgyud gang skyes skad cig la/ /dran pas gzung zhing ma yengs gnyen po bsten/ /sgo gsum bag yod shes bzhin ngo tsha shes/ /khrel yod ldan pas rang rgyud gdul bar bya/ /bstod smad dgag sgrub snyan dang mi snyan la/ /sgyu ma rmi lam bden med mgo snyoms bya/ /brag ca'i sgra ltar rjes mthun bzod pa bsgom/ /nga bdag 'dzin pa'i sems kyi rtsa ba bcad/ /mdor na ci byed chos dang mi 'gal bas/ /rang gi rgyud bsdams gzhan la mi gnod cing*/ /nyon mongs phyogs su skad cig ma song bar/ /nyin mtshan dge bas 'da' ba shin tu gces/ /deng sang dus na skye bo mi srun pas/ /dben sar rang don sgrub pa shin tu gces/ /'dab gshog ma rdzogs 'phur bar mi nus ltar/ /mngon shes mi ldan gzhan don mi nus pas*/ /rang don lhur blangs yid kyis gzhan don bsam/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi bdud kyi bslu brid 'dis/ /rang sems ma bslus sgrub la 'bad pa gces/ /'chi dus 'gyod pas gdung bar ma byed cig /de bas da lta sems la ser btab ste/ /da lta 'chi na khyer so ci 'dug ltos/ /gar 'gro cir 'gyur gtad so ma zin par/ /rnam g.yeng 'khrul pas nyin mtshan 'da' ba 'di/ /dal 'byor don med chud zos byed pas na/ /gcig pur dben par snying po'i don bsgoms shing*/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma da res legs dgos so/ /phyi nas gar 'gro bdag la cha yod dam/

/de bas de ring nyid du brtson par bya/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang 'dra/ /'di las thar thabs dgos so sems la zung*/ /da res 'khrul na gtan du 'khrul par 'khyams/ /de bas brtson pa skyed cig snying la zhog /nyon mongs rgya mtsho bdag 'dzin brgal dka'i mtsho/ /dal 'byor gru bos da res brgal bar bya/ /thar lam byang chung brgya lam res 'ga' zhig /bsod nams dbang gis snang ba'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /snying nas brtson pas phan bde bsgrub par bya/ /tshe yang mi rtag skad cig 'gyur ba ste/ / rnam g.yeng bslu mkhas phyi bshol dge la byed/ /'khrul pa rgyun ring goms pa brtan pas na/ /nyon mongs phyogs ni skad cig ngang gis 'du/ /bsod nams dge la 'bad kyang 'byung dka' bas/ /las kyi gdung shugs bzlog la 'bad pa gces/ /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba cung zad med/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal bsams na bzod glags med/ /'di las thar thabs da res brtsam par bya/ / snying nas snying po'i don la ma 'bad na/ /dal khom res 'ga'i chos kyis phan mi thogs/ /de bas mi rtag skyo shas cher bskyed de/ /skad cig ma yengs sgrub la brtson 'grus bskyed/ /de ltar dang po nyid du rtogs byas na/ /phyis nas 'phags pa'i go 'phang myur du 'thob/ /rang don 'grub cing gzhan don ngang gis 'byung*/ /'khor ba'i gnas las thar ba'i lam mchog rnyed/ /de phyir ci byed chos dang bstun pa ni/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i rten gyi gang zag yin/ / rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso las/ /gang gis bsgoms pa'i gang zag bstan pa ste gnas gnyis pa'o// // gsum pa nyams su blang bya'i chos la gsum/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa 'o/ /dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bstan pa/ /mi rtag skyo shas spyi yi sngon 'gro ste/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa gting nas zlog par byed/ /snying rje sems bskyed bye brag sngon 'gro ste/

/theg chen lam du chos rnams 'gro bar byed/ /de phyir thog mar sngon 'gro rnam gnyis sbyong*/ /de rjes khyad par mchog gi sngon 'gro ni/ /dbang rdzogs thob nas bskyed pa rim gnyis te/ /rang lus lha dang snod bcud lhar gsal bas/ /tha mal 'dzin pa'i zhen pa zlog par byed/ /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa yis/ /byin rlabs tshad med rtogs pa shugs las 'char/ /bar chad kun sel dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /de phyir de rjes sngon 'gro mchog gnyis bsgom/ /de ltar sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bzhi yis/ /ma nor lam du sems nyid tshud pa dang*/ /thar lam mchog zin gnas lugs myur du skye/ /dngos gzhi 'byongs sla bar chad med pa dang*/ /dngos grub nye sogs yon tan tshad med ldan/ /de phyir sngon 'gro 'byongs pa shin tu gces/ /dngos gzhi'i rnam pa'ang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i/ /bsam gtan thabs las gnas lugs ngo sprod de/ /'od gsal spros dang bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa 'char ba yin/ /dang po bde chen thabs la ngo sprod pa/ /de yang sngon 'gro sngar bzhin bsgoms pa'i rjes/ /'khor lo bzhi dbus rtsa gsum ka ba'i tshul/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing sbubs ma can/ /yar sna tshangs bug mar sna gsang gnas te/ /lte ba'i thad drang dbu ma'i nang a las/ /me 'bar spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi bab/ /'khor lo bzhi dang lus nang kun gang ste/ /bde bas khyab dus snying gar bam̐ yig la/ /ham̐ gi bdud rtsi rgyun chad med par 'bab/ /bde ba'i nyams ni ma skyes bar du bsgom/ /de nas bam̐ yang je chung je phra las/ /dmigs bsam spros dang bral ba'i ngang du gzhag /thabs des sems zin bde bas zhi gnas skye/ /de nas gang yang brjod las 'das pa'i sems/ /blo bral nam mkha' 'dra ba'i ngang nyid 'char/ /de ni 'od gsal bde stong rdzogs pa che/ /dngas shing bsam gyis mi khyab chos nyid yin/

/de nyid goms las nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi/ /gang snang thams cad bde bar 'char ba dang*/ /nyin mtshan bde ba'i ngang las 'bral mi phod/ /chags sdang la sogs zug rngus rgyud mi 'khrugs/ /chos kyi tshig don rtogs pa'i shes rab skye/ /de nas yang bsgoms spyan dang mngon shes sogs/ /yon tan dpag med nyi ma sems la 'char/ /'di ni yang zab gnad kyi gdams pa yin/ /gnyis pa gsal ba'i thabs kyi ngo sprad pa/ /sngon 'gro sngar bzhin rtsa gsum gsal btab pa'i/ /ro rkyang gug pa dbu mar 'jug pa'i tshul/ /mar snar bsgoms la yar snar sna bug gtad/ /rlung ro gsum bus nad gdon sdig sgrib song*/ /dal bus tshur rngubs brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten kun/ /'od zhu sna nas tshur byung ro rkyang nas/ /dbu ma'i nang byung snying dbus tshon gang 'od/ /gong bu la thim thub thang bar du gzung*/ /steng 'og kha sbyar gtong dus cung zad gzung*/ /dal bus 'byung rngubs bya ba shin tu gces/ / gzhan yang sangs rgyas la sogs yon tan kun/ /snying gar thim las gzhan du ma yengs bya/ /thabs des sems gsal dngas la gnas pa 'byung*/ /de rjes snying ga'i 'od las 'od mched de/ /lus nang 'khor lo bzhi nang 'bar ba las/ /phyir mched 'jig rten 'od kyis gang bar bsgom/ /zhag 'gar nyin mtshan de nyid don bsgoms pas/ /rmi lam 'gag dang 'od kyi snang ba ni/ /zla ba 'bar ba me khyer skar ma sogs/ /'od lnga'i snang bas phyi nang khyab pa mthong*/ /gsal ba'i ngang du sems zin zhi gnas skye/ /de nas slar bsdu snying ga'i 'od de yang*/ /je chung je phrar stong nyid ngang la gzhag /gang du'ang mi dmigs stong gsal dngas pa'i sems/ /rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba 'char/ /de ni gsal stong gnyug ma'i ye shes te/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ /de nyid goms las nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi/ / gang snang 'al 'ol zang thal gsal ba snyam/ /nyin mtshan gsal ba'i ngang la gnas pa dang*/

rnam rtog mi g.yo sems gsal dwangs pa dang*/ /shes rab klong rdol gzung 'dzin bral ba 'o/ /de yang goms las mngon shes 'char ba dang*/ / sgrib pas chod kyang pha rol zang thal sogs/ /mthong ba'i spyan dang rdzu 'phrul 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di ni yang zab gdams pa'i nying khu yin/ /gsum pa mi rtog thabs kyis ngo sprad nas/ /sngon 'gro sngar bzhin dngos gzhi rnam pa gsum/ /'phang ba gzung ba sbyang ba'i rim pa las/ /'phang ba snying gar sems nyid 'od gsal ba/ /ha 'am 'od kyi gong bu tshon gang zhig /ha zhes nyer gcig ngar dang bcas brjod pas/ /rgyangs kyis spyi gtsug nas 'thon mkha' la song*/ /je mtho je mthor mthar ni bltar med pa'i/ /ngang du lus sems khong glod mnyam par bzhag /skad cig de la rnam rtog rgyun chad de/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i ngang la gnas/ /nyams kyang bltar med bsam yul 'das pa 'byung*/ /gzung ba nyi ma'i ngos la rgyab gtad de/ /dngas pa'i mkha' la mig gtad lhan ner gzhag /rlung rgyu mi tshor ci nas dal bar bya/ /mi rtog spros dang bral ba khong nas 'char/ /rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu'i nyams skye'o/ /sbyang ba mkha' la mig gtad ma yengs par/ /sems gsal spro bsdu med pa'i ngang de nas/ /sa rdo ri brag snod bcud thams cad kyang*/ /zang thal nam mkha' gcig tu song bar bsgom/ /rang gi lus kyang rags pa'i dngos med de/ /sems dang nam mkha' dbyer med ngang du gzhag /phyi nang bar gsum rnam dbye med pa'i chos/ /nam mkha'i ngang der lus sems khong glod la/ /dran bsam yid la phyed pa rang zhi'i ngang*/ /spro bsdu med pa'i sems nyid rang sor gzhag /de tshe chos nyid bsam brjod 'das pa'i sems/ /gnyis med nam mkha' lta bu'i dgos pa 'char/ /'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i snying po yin/ /de ltar bsgoms pas nyams kyang rnam pa bzhi/ /gang snang phyam phyam rags pa'i 'du shes med/ /nyin mtshan mi rtog ngang las 'bral mi phod/

/dug lnga rang zhi sems rgyud 'jam la des/ /chos kun nam mkha' 'dra ba'i nyams myong skye/ /de ltar mi rtog gsum la goms pa yis/ /spyan dang mngon shes ting 'dzin yon tan 'grub/ /thabs dang shes rab zhi lhag zung 'brel bas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis phun sum tshogs/ /gsum pa rjes kyi chos la rnam pa bzhi/ /nyams dang bogs 'byin rtogs pa 'bras bu'o/ /nyams la gnyis las skyon med sngar bstan la/ / skyon can so so'i 'dzin zhen las byung ba/ /bde chags gsal chags mi rtogs chags pa dang*/ /mthar 'dzin zhen rtog dug dang 'dres pa gsum/ /bde log khams 'dzag 'dod chags rang ga dang*/ /snying mi dga' dang bying ba shas che dang*/ /gsal log rlung rgod zhe sdang rang ga dang*/ /rnam rtog rags dang rgod dang 'phro shas che/ /mi rtog log pa gti mug rang ga dang*/ /sems bying gnyid rmugs che dang 'du shes med/ /de ltar mthun dang log pa'i skyon can rnams/ / gang byung ngos gzung gnyen pos bcos par bya/ /bogs 'byin nyams bcos thabs dang gong du spel/ /nyams bcos pa yang rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /rab kyis lta bas bcos te chos rnams kun/ /blo btags sgyu 'dra ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /phyam gcig mkha' 'dra snyems bral rang ngos stong*/ /'dzin zhen med pa'i ngang der la bzla 'o/ /gol sgrib nyams de gnas lugs chen por 'char/ /bar chad dge bskul rkyen ngan byang chub grogs/ /gzhi bde'i steng du blo bde rgyun mi 'chad/ /'bring gis sgom pas bcos te dngas phyung la/ /shes pa 'gyur la thebs shing dran pas gzung/ /ma yengs bde gsal mi rtog ngang la gzhag /yengs dang 'jur la ma thebs skyon yin pas/ /skad cig ma yengs ngang la gzhag pa gces/ /khams 'dzag pa la rdo rje'i bum pa ru/ /hūm̐ las me 'bar lus nang khams kun bsregs/ /ci yang med pa'i ngang la bsgoms pas sel/ /nad 'dzag gdon 'dzag gang la'ang gnad 'di zab/

/bde la 'dzin pa bshig nas stong par bsgoms/ /'dod chags rang ga'i sems la cher bltas te/ /bcos bslad re dogs med pa'i ngang bzhag pas/ /'dod chags rang grol bde stong ye shes 'char/ /snying mi dga' ba thig le nyams pa'i skyon/ /de la 'bar 'dzag bde ba'i bsam gtan bsgom/ /bying shas che na dngas snyigs ma phyed skyon/ /de la lus gnad drang por 'dug byas la/ /kha sbyar rlung bzung snying nang 'od kyis khengs/ /snang srid 'od khengs gsal stong bsgoms pas grol/ /gsal 'dzin nyams la 'dzin med chen por sbyong*/ /gsal 'dzin rmugs na dngas gsal sems bsgom zhing*/ /rgod cing 'phro na mig btsums snying nang du/ /'od dang yi ge pad+ma ral gri'am/ /rgya gram bsgoms pa je dma' je dma' las/ snying gi nang nas lung thag je ring song*/ /'og gzhi gser gyi sa gzhir bab par bsgom/ /des ni mi sel mi srid nges pa'i gnad/ /zhe sdang rang ga 'phros thog tsen ne gzhag /gsal stong me long ye shes ngang du grol/ / mi rtog ngang 'char 'dzin med gnad kyis sbyang*/ /gti mug sems de ngos gzung cer gyis brtag /skad cig rang grol chos dbyings ye shes 'char/ /bying zhing rmugs te 'du shes med pa na/ /snying nang 'od bsgoms tshangs bug nas 'thon te/ /gzhu gang tsam gyi nam mkhar lding nger gnas/ /'di ni yang zab gnad kyi gdams pa yin/ /spyir ni gang la'ang 'dzin med gnad du che/ /re dogs bral na gegs rnam kun las grol/ /stong gsal sems nyid dngas pa'i ngang nyid du/ /blo yi rnam pa spro bsdu med par gzhag /gegs dang spang bya'i 'phrang las grol bar nges/ /tha mas spyod pas bcos pa'i rim pa yang*/ /lta stangs rdzas dang rten 'brel gsum nyid las/ /spyi yi lta stangs rnam snang chos bdun te/ /skyil krung mig mi 'gul dang rlung dal dang*/ /mnyam gzhag mgrin pa gug dang lce rtse rkan/ /sna rtser mig phab blta bas rlung sems snyoms/

/bying rgod med cing ma nor bsam gtan skye/ /'di ltar skyon kun lus gnad 'khrugs pa yis/ /rtsa 'khrugs rlung 'khrugs thig le 'khrugs pa las/ /'byung bas ma dkrugs mnyam par gzhag pa gces/ /yon tan yang ni rtsa thig rlung gsum nyid/ /mi g.yo gnad du song las 'byung bas na/ /de phyir gnad 'di rtogs pa rab tu gces/ /'khrul 'khor lus sbyong gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ / khyad par dal 'jam ma 'khrugs gnad kyi dus/ /'jam la rtsub dang rtsub la 'jam pa gnad/ /khams dang bstun pa shin tu gces pa yin/ /bye brag bde la lag pa gru mor bsnol/ /mig phab bde la sems gzung gnad yin no/ / gsal la lag gnyis pus mo'i steng du dgab/ /rlung dal mig ni bar snang har por blta/ /mi rtog chos bdun ngang gar gnas pas 'grub/ /rdzas ni dus dang mthun pa'i gnas dang grogs/ /bza' btung la sogs nyams la gang phan bsten/ /rten 'brel khams 'dzag pa la gzhon nu mas/ /bkal ba'i skud pa sum sgril sngags bzlas te/ /sked par btags pas thig le bsrung ba yin/ /rtog pa 'phro na tsan+dan ge sar dang*/ /zhun chen ril bu bsten pas mi rtog 'grub/ /rmugs na gur gum ga pur byang chub sems/ /ril bus ting 'dzin 'grub par rgyud las gsungs/ /bde gsal mi rtog skyon med gong 'phel ba/ /dmigs pa gang rung sems bzung mchog tu bsngags/ /dang por dmigs yul la gtad bsgoms pa yis/ /de rjes dmigs med ngang du lhan gyis 'gro/ /gnad 'di shin tu yang zab mchog yin pas/ /skal ldan rnams kyis dang du blang bar bya/ /mtshan bcas yin zhes spang ba blun po'i lam/ / nyams myong med pa'i lugs yin dor bar bya/ /khyad par bde ba'i bogs 'byin dam pa ni/ /'og rlung 'then la gsang ba'i gnas nyid nas/ /thig le yar thim spyi gtsug nyid du thim/ /gang yang dmigs med ngang la bzhag par bya/ /de rjes steng 'og kha sbyar rlung bzung la/ /snying gar sems gtad skye med ngang la gzhag

/bde gsal spros bral ngang la gnas pa yin/ /bar bar seng ge rtsal sprugs la sogs pa/ /dbab bzlog drang zhing dgram dang la bzla ba'i/ / 'khrul 'khor dmigs gnad mthong ba brgyud bzhin bya/ /dbab pa 'khyud bri'i phyag rgya nyid dang ni/ /ro stod smad gsigs gnon pa lta bur bya/ /dmigs pa ham̐ las byang sems babs pa yis/ /gsang bar byung dus bde la dmigs pa gtad/ /bzlog pa de nas gyen du drangs pa ste/ lag gnyis mkhal khung rgya mtsho brag la sbyar/ /'od rlung 'then la lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ /mig sprin bzlog cing mgo bsgril 'dar ba bzhin/ /dmigs pa thig le ba thag brgyus pa bzhin/ / gcig la gcig thim spyi gtsug bar du bsam/ /dgram pa gzhu 'gengs rkang lag rtsal sprugs bya/ /si zhes lce rtse so sbyar rlung phyir 'bud/ /la bzla gan rkyal rlung sems sos dal la/ /gar yang mi rtog cir yang mi 'dzin pas/ / rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i ngang la gzhag /'di yis gegs med bde chen byang chub 'grub/ /gsal ba rlung gi bogs 'byin dam pa yang*/ /'jam rtsub gcig gis gcig gi bogs 'byin la/ /khyad par nang bzung phyir bzung gcig gis gcig/ dal 'jam phan tshun gnad dang bsre ba gces/ /grangs dang kha dog reg bya dbyibs la sogs/ /du ma'i thabs la bslab pa'ang gsungs mod kyi/ /'dir ni gcig gis kun 'grub man ngag la/ /'di ltar bslal pa gnad kyi rgyal po yin/ /lus gnad khyad par sngar bzhin lus mi 'gul/ /rlung ni kha sna gsum mnyam shin tu dal/ /tha mal rang grol ngang la lhan gyis glod/ /sems gnad gang du'ang mi gzung rang bzhin bya/ /de rjes gan rkyal rkang lag brgyang byas te/ /ha zhes drag la sems ni mkha' dkyil gtad/ /yeng med spro bsdu bral ba lhan ner gzhag /rlung sems rang grol gdod ma'i ngang gnas pa/ /gegs med yon tan 'char sgo dpag tu med/ / lus yang rgyu ba med dang spros pa zhi/ /sems gsal rab tu dngas shing mngon shes 'char/

/rkang mgyogs 'grub cing mdog snum ting 'dzin skye/ /rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa'i rtags rnams 'byung*/ /yang zab gnad kyi mchog yin shin tu gsang*/ /mi rtog nam mkha' lta bu'i bogs 'byin yang*/ /lus sems khong glod dmigs pa rtse gcig bzung*/ /gcig la ma yengs cer re bltas pa yis/ /rnam rtog gzhan rnams de yi ngang nub ste/ /dmigs rten de la rtog pa'ang rab zhi nas/ /snang la der 'dzin med pa'i rtogs pa 'char/ /'di ni gnad yin gzhan yang 'di ltar bslab/ /res 'ga' dmigs pa phyir bzung rlung phu la/ /phyi ru ci gnas gzhag pas mi rtog skye/ /res 'ga' nang bzung stod smad gang rung du/ /dmigs rten gcig la ma yengs tsen ne gzhag / res 'ga' rten med shes pa rang zhir gzhag /yul snang der 'dzin med pa'i ngang la gnas/ /'di ni mi rtog chos sku'i dgongs pa ste/ /gnad la brten nas rang byung khong nas 'char/ /bde gsal mi rtog spyi yi bogs 'byin ni/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pa dang*/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchog tu bsngags/ /'di ni mthar thug gnad kyi gdams pa ste/ /skal bzang thar ba 'dod pas dang du blang*/ /de ltar bsgoms pas shar ba'i rtogs pa yang*/ /ro mnyam gcig ste tha dad du ma med/ /phyogs gsum gcig tu 'du ba'i don sa dang*/ /chu bran tha dad rgya mtshor gcig pa ltar/ /bde gsal mi rtog thabs gsum gang bsgoms kyang*/ /sems nyid ma skyes nam mkha'i ngang nyid du/ /blo yi 'jug pa rab zhi thim pa na/ /yod med spros dang bral ba'i byang chub sems/ /'od gsal gshis kyi nyi ma khong nas 'char/ /grub bsal 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rtogs pa ste/ /mkha' mnyam bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin no/ /de tshe rtse gcig dngas gsal rnyog med pa/ /zhi lhag spangs pa'i bsam gtan rgya mtsho la/ /phyogs bral 'dzin med gzugs brnyan rang bzhin med/ /chos kun rtogs pa'i ngo bo zung du 'brel/

/snang ba sgyu 'dra stong pa der 'dzin med/ /zung 'jug dbyer med dgongs klong yangs pa ni/ /gnad las byung ba'i 'od gsal khong nas 'char/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs rang byung ye shes ni/ /tshig dang bsam brjod 'das tshe mthong ba ste/ /de lta bu nyid dus su mthong ba ni/ /dus gsum dus med phyi nang dbye bsal med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin yin dbu ma ste/ /spros dang sdug bsngal zhi byed phyag rgya che/ /snying po'i chos nyid rdzogs pa chen po ste/ /gdod ma'i zad pa gshis kyi gnas lugs nyid/ /'od gsal sems nyid rang byung ye shes yin/ /ming mang btags kyang don gyi ngo bo gcig /sems nyid smra bsam brjod 'das byang chub sems/ /'khor 'das gnyis med nam mkha' lta bu yin/ /phyogs ris ma 'dzin grub mtha'i gzeb las 'das/ /phyogs bral gnyis med mnyam rdzogs chen po ste/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' bral klong yangs su/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis yongs su shes par bya/ /de dag mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rim pa ni/ /gnas skabs bde gsal mi rtog zung 'jug gis/ /spyan dang mngon shes yon tan dpag med cing*/ / mthar thug sku gsum yid bzhin rgyal chos 'grub/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso las/ /gang bsgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ste gnas gsum pa'o// // de ltar chos tshul zhi ba snying po'i don/ /zab cing rgya che bshad pa'i bsod nams des/ /'gro kun byang chub dam pa gnyis thob nas/ /yid bzhin 'phrin las 'byor pa mtha' yas shog /'di ni rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /rang gi nyams len gnad dril bcud bsdus te/ /phyi rabs don du gsal bar bshad pa ni/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gis brtson byas te/ /yi ge 'di bzhin nyams su blang bar mdzod/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis phun tshogs te/

/bde chen gling du myur du dga' bde byed/ /rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso zhes bya ba/ /dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po mtsho skyes rdo rjes rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du legs par bkod pa rdzogs so/ /dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (22) rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso/ - PAGE 190 -- PAGE 191 -- PAGE 175 -
